verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single community remark that Outlook has a Copilot integration, which confirms an in-product AI assistant exists. Nothing describes it generating insights or suggestions from the user's mail data, and the user found copy-pasting into another client faster. The Graph people-suggestion API is a developer building block for apps, not in-product AI insights, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Copilot or other AI features in Outlook, evidence of AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's own mailbox or calendar data, and hands-on corroboration of their quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
